wish.safety: This exercise is for everyday wishes, like learning, work, friends or a habit. It isn't for painful experiences such as loss, abuse or health worries, or for times of crisis. If that's where you are, talk to someone you trust or a support line. It also isn't for wishes about changing another person, or for big changes to eating or your body. You can stop at any time.
wish.ask: Think of something you'd really like to happen in the next four weeks. It should matter to you and be a challenge, but be possible.
wish.field_label: My wish, in a few words (only you see this; it isn't saved)
wish.example: For example: finish the first draft of my essay.

matter.label: How much does this matter to you?

likely.label: How likely do you think it is to happen?

outcome.ask: What would be the best thing about this wish coming true? Name the one that matters most to you.
outcome.field_label: The best part, in a few words (only you see this; it isn't saved)
outcome.picture: Now picture it. Imagine it happening, as clearly as you can. Take as long as you like.

obstacle.ask: Things can get in the way. What in you is most likely to get in the way of this? It might be a habit, a feeling or a thought.

cards.text: I put it off when I'm tired.
cards.if_text: I'm tired and want to put it off

cards.text: I get distracted by my phone.
I avoid it when it feels hard.
I worry about how it will go.
cards.if_text: I start to worry about how it will go

cards.text: I say yes to other things first.
cards.if_text: someone asks me to do something else first

obstacle.own_label: What gets in the way, in a few words (only you see this; it isn't saved)
obstacle.outside_label: What is it, in a few words (only you see this; it isn't saved)
obstacle.picture: Now picture the moment it happens. Where are you? What's going on? Take as long as you like.

decide.lead: Here's what you want, and what's in the way.
decide.outside_note: You said this is mostly outside you. A plan can only cover the part you can do something about.

likely.label: Now that you've looked at both, how likely do you think it is to happen?

decide.compared: Earlier you said {before}, and now you say {now}. No direction is expected. This shows how it looks to you right now, not whether it will happen.
decide.ask: What do you want to do with this wish?

options.label: Keep it
options.hint: Go ahead with it as it is.

options.label: Change it
options.hint: Make it something you'd rather go for.

decide.new_wish_label: My wish now, in a few words (only you see this; it isn't saved)
decide.any_answer: Any of these is a fine answer. This exercise can't tell you whether your wish is realistic. That's up to you.

plan.lead: Plan for the moment it happens.
plan.if_label: If… (only you see this; it isn't saved)

then_cards.text: put my phone in another room.
ask someone to do it with me.
remind myself of the best part.
write down one small next step.

plan.own_label: Then I will, in a few words (only you see this; it isn't saved)
plan.rehearse: Say it to yourself slowly, once or twice.
set_aside: You've set this wish aside. That's a real decision too.
You can come back to it whenever you like, or try this exercise with a different wish.

close.copy_note: It isn't saved here, so copy it if you want to keep it.
close.copy_failed: That didn't work. You can select the plan above and copy it yourself.

ready.label: How ready do you feel to act on your plan?

close.ready_means: This shows how it feels right now, not whether the exercise works.
close.feeling_ask: How has this left you feeling about the wish?
close.discouraged_note: Looking closely at what's in the way can feel discouraging, and that's understandable. It doesn't say anything about you. If it stays with you, talk to someone you trust or a support line.
